mn108:6.6: ‘Worthy Ānanda, is there even a single mendicant who has all the same qualities in each and every way as possessed by the worthy Gotama, the perfected one, the fully awakened Buddha?’
mn108:6.7: When he said this, I said to the brahmin Moggallāna the Guardian:
mn108:6.8: ‘There is no single mendicant who has all the same qualities in each and every way as possessed by the worthy Gotama, the perfected one, the fully awakened Buddha.
mn108:6.9: For the Blessed One gave rise to the unarisen path, gave birth to the unborn path, and explained the unexplained path. He is the knower of the path, the discoverer of the path, the expert on the path.
mn108:6.10: And now the disciples live following the path; they acquire it later.’
mn108:6.11: This is the conversation between us and Moggallāna the Guardian that was left unfinished.
